description: The function fn entry_id_to_cid(id: &LogEntryId) -> Cid (wrapping the 32 raw bytes as SHA2-256 multihash DAG-CBOR CIDv1) is duplicated in tests/group_log_vectors.rs, tests/reconcile_convergence.rs, and group_log/append.rs. It should be extracted to a single location — either a method on LogEntryId (LogEntryId::to_cid()) which already exists in types.rs, or a re-export. The tests are already calling append.rs's own to_cid() indirectly; they should use the same path.
title: core: entry_id_to_cid helper copy-pasted across three test modules
